subject.title: [Bug]: WHAM probe with expired access token puts refreshable OpenAI profile into false 12h cooldown

question: Should maintainers accept the narrow linked fix that skips WHAM probing for locally expired OpenAI OAuth access tokens?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and already has an open closing PR, but the issue is protected and the touched path is auth/secops-owned.

options.title: Review and land the linked fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102479 passes review and CI, then let the merged PR close it.

options.title: Choose a different auth-owned fix
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for an alternate patch if maintainers want the expiry check to use a shared OAuth usability helper or a different WHAM policy.

options.title: Fold into broader auth hardening
options.body: Keep this issue open as a child of broader OpenAI OAuth cooldown/fallback work if maintainers do not want a standalone fix.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102479 passes review and CI, then let the merged PR close it.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the clearest maintainer-routing candidate from recent current-main auth-profile history and the protected auth/secops ownership context.
